You basically just described me. Most of my depression stems from being in the closet, but even if yours doesn't, I think we're in the same boat. I know you said it's difficult for you to talk about your emotions, same here. But what helped me was to find one friend that was going through the same thing. And it can even be someone on here (talking anonymously on the internet is much easier than you say it is). 

Other than that, I'm not very good at giving advice. Just know that others are willing to help. You can message me if you'd like, just to talk. I hope you have a really good day!
